findings.title: Exchange failures are not compensated; an intervening saveRoot mkdir can destroy automatic rollback recovery
findings.trigger: Fail after old rename or terminate between old/new renames; restart, export before game launch, then launch.
findings.effect: Original is not restored on failure; empty committed created by export causes recover to delete before-import/staging. The private old ZIP normally remains; permanent loss of every copy is not claimed.

evidence.claim: Backup, journal/renames, finally cleanup and existence-only recovery
saveRoot creates directory; initialize only recovers Installation
Only save recovery call occurs on launch, before launch saveRoot

findings.correction: Recover under operationLock before all committed-path access/creation; preserve verified old/new identities and phase; compensate reported failures before lock release, durably register index before cleanup, and sync backup/staging directory entries.
findings.verification: Fault every journal/rename/fsync/index boundary; interpose export/import/upgrade/App backup before launch; repeat recovery and assert valid tree plus index.

findings.title: Main-process recreation can turn a live native session into an accepted idle record
findings.trigger: Native :game survives only main-process reclamation; reconstruct hall and export/import same game.
findings.effect: initialize marks unfinished records crashed without live-owner reconciliation; backend and UI allow save operations while native can still own/commit its working save. Device survival precondition is not experimentally verified.

evidence.claim: Blindly ends prior sessions on initialize
crashed state excluded from unfinished
Idle authority depends solely on unfinished records
Final idle recheck uses same authority
Dead host sends swallowed; no game-side host-death teardown
Game activity/service have separate process
Import always enabled

findings.correction: Reconcile or stop actual native owner before ending persistent session; block unresolved ownership, add interprocess save guard where needed, and disable running-state UI import using same authority.
findings.verification: Preserve :game across main restart and attempt import/export; separately verify ordinary launch/import lock exclusion.

findings.title: Import confirmation and retry do not retain the inspected archive state
findings.trigger: Recreate confirmation after picker inspection, or fail import then press Confirm again.
findings.effect: Restored dialog has null importArchive and Confirm silently returns; failed import retains dialog but deletes its file. Pending URI copy/parse has no durable operation receipt. Picker-open recreation is not asserted to fail.

evidence.claim: selected/route/dialog saveable; archive pair remember-only; result consumed asynchronously
Null-pair Confirm no-op and success-only UI clear
Every entered try exit deletes cache archive
Failure notice without restoring/clearing import state

findings.correction: Persist small owned pending-import context/status and reparse on restore; retain usable cache on recoverable failure; handle reclaimed cache by explicit reselect; clean on cancel/durable success.
findings.verification: Recreate while picker open, after result, during copy, on confirmation, and after validation/backup failure.

findings.title: Visible Cancel dismisses the dialog while the background import continues
findings.trigger: Confirm; wait until verified staging and old-save backup; tap still-enabled Cancel or dismiss.
findings.effect: Captured model action continues through directory exchange even though Cancel returns UI. Repeated Confirm also queues a stale duplicate.

evidence.claim: Cancel deletes pair/hides dialog, no working guard or cancellation intent
Model action survives dialog dismissal; queued action mutex
No cancellation predicate between extraction, backup and rename

findings.correction: Single operation owner/re-entry guard and safe-boundary cancellation intent; disable Cancel/outside dismissal once publication becomes noncancellable and show truthful phase.
findings.verification: Cancel/dismiss through validation/backup/exchange; verify no cancelled overwrite and no duplicate action.

findings.title: Expanded-byte cap is enforced after writing and hashing an oversized file
findings.trigger: Small compressed archive claims total below 2 GiB but indexed entry bytes/ZIP size exceeds cap with matching contents/hash.
findings.effect: Full oversized expansion is written before total check; can exhaust internal disk though committed tree is not intentionally moved.

evidence.claim: Compressed copy and claimed total bounded
Per-entry self bound only; aggregate maximum after complete write/fsync/hash

findings.correction: Preflight checked sum/file caps/equality and independent cumulative expansion budget before every write; keep exact entry/hash checks and space planning.
findings.verification: Mock/bound writes to assert cap before oversize allocation; individual and cumulative bomb plus overflow cases.

findings.title: Required metadata fields and control-character path rules are not fully enforced
findings.trigger: Correct archive omits source_release_id/commit_seq/created_at, or has matching file path containing U+000A.
findings.effect: Malformed save schema or prohibited control-character path can pass all final checks. No arbitrary root escape is claimed.

evidence.claim: Only selected metadata fields read
Final checks do not require provenance/sequence/time
No control-character exclusion
Required fields and supported property policy

findings.correction: Enforce complete save-schema shape/type/identifier/time/sequence rules and shared explicit control-character rejection before filesystem writes; do not require platform signature.
findings.verification: Missing/invalid fields and control/NUL/DEL paths alongside existing traversal/mode/hash rejection.

findings.title: Successful import does not update or register a durable save index
findings.trigger: Persisted save sequence 12; import compatible source commit 3; immediately export before another native save.
findings.effect: Re-export uses old sequence/current active-release metadata; imported origin/digest/commit linkage is lost and no import index transaction exists.

evidence.claim: Export derives metadata from old fact/current install
Import and recovery contain no DAO mutation or saved commit record
Only later native event updates save-seq fact
No save commit/backup entity or import index writer

findings.correction: Persist verified import commit/source provenance and reconcile index with exchange journal before deleting rollback state; separate local monotonic revision from origin archive sequence.
findings.verification: Import/re-export provenance/index consistency and restart at publication/index boundaries; exactly-once recovery.

findings.title: 2048 staging file is inside the committed tree and included in exports after interrupted saves
findings.trigger: Short-write/fsync/rename failure or termination after state.new creation before rename, then export idle without another successful save.
findings.effect: Uncommitted or partial state.new is packaged, potentially as the only file despite no completed first commit.

evidence.claim: Staging state.new inside save_root; failure leaves it
Startup only loads state.dat, no staging cleanup
Every file under root exported without commit-file authority
2048 is a current compiled slot

findings.correction: Stage demo writes outside committed tree and durably publish only valid state; clean only owned staging or use authoritative committed-file index, avoiding global filename suffix blacklists.
findings.verification: 2048 short-write/fsync/rename interruption then export: only committed state.dat, no false nonempty backup before first commit.
